description: This Java source file defines a custom annotation @AddOnStartup used for marking constants with metadata like description and core status, typically for integration during application startup in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: AddOnStartup
classes.description: A Java annotation used to describe constants in core classes, indicating whether they should be loaded at startup and providing descriptions for them.

methods.name: description
methods.description: An annotation attribute that provides a description of the constant.

methods.name: core
methods.description: An annotation attribute indicating whether the constant is a core constant (default true).
